title: Wynn Hosts Bocuse d'Or Asia-Pacific 2026 Closing Party

body_markdown:
*Wynn celebrates global culinary excellence by showcasing the city's vibrant local flavors*


**Macao, November 4, 2026** — For the first time, Macao welcomed the prestigious Bocuse d'Or Asia-Pacific 2026, hosted by the Macao Government Tourism Office from November 1 to 2. As the event's official Hospitality Partner, Wynn hosted the Closing Party at the Wynn Palace Grand Theater on the evening of November 2 – a fitting grand finale for the two-day competition. Approximately 250 participating chefs, competition judges, industry professionals, and members of the international media gathered to celebrate the exceptional achievements of leading culinary talent from across the Asia-Pacific region. By supporting this renowned global gastronomic event, Wynn continues to build a gastronomic bridge between Macao and the world, while also elevating the city's profile as a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy and a "World Centre of Tourism and Leisure."


Established in 1987, Bocuse d'Or is widely regarded as the "Olympics of Gastronomy" for its exacting professional standards and rigorous competition format. The Asia-Pacific 2026 regional selection marks the first time for Macao to host this prestigious global culinary competition, which last took place in the region in 2018. Following two days of intense competition, Japan, Thailand, and China claimed first, second, and third place respectively, with New Zealand and Malaysia finishing fourth and fifth. The five teams will advance to the Bocuse d'Or Grand Final in Lyon, France, in January 2027.


The Asia-Pacific 2026 edition holds special significance for Wynn. Peter Chan, Executive Chef of Wynn Macau, has been appointed Honorary President of Bocuse d'Or Asia-Pacific 2026 – the only chef from Macao to receive this distinction. Chef Chan's distinguished global career is anchored by his landmark achievement in 2012, when he led Wing Lei at Wynn Macau to earn its first two MICHELIN stars. His appointment not only recognizes his culinary expertise but also reflects Wynn's longstanding commitment to nurturing culinary talent and delivering exceptional dining experiences in Macao. Wynn's connection with the competition dates back to the bidding stage. During Macao's 2025 bid to host the Bocuse d'Or Asia-Pacific 2026, Chef Tam Kwok Fung, Executive Chef of Chef Tam's Seasons at Wynn Palace, lent his support to the bid, helping to highlight Macao's rich and diverse culinary culture as well as its capability to host prestigious international culinary events.


The Closing Party brought together an esteemed gathering of distinguished guests, including Mr. Cheng Wai Tong, Acting Director of the Macao Government Tourism Office; Mr. Jérôme Bocuse, President of Bocuse d'Or Competition; Mr. Olivier Ginon, Chairman of GL Events; Ms. Inès Ginon, President of GL Events Greater China; and Ms. Linda Chen, President, Vice Chairman and Executive Director of Wynn Macau, Limited.


Speaking at the event, Ms. Linda Chen said: "I would like to thank the Macao Government Tourism Office for bringing Bocuse d'Or Asia-Pacific to Macao. Events like this showcase the very best of Macao and strengthen Macao's position as a World Centre of Tourism and Leisure, and Wynn is proud to support that vision as the Hospitality Partner. Bocuse d'Or brings chefs together across borders, celebrates excellence, and inspires the next generation of culinary talent. At Wynn, we share that commitment to nurturing talent and exchanging ideas, and we are proud to be part of this year's journey here in Macao."


Inspired by Macao's distinctive culinary heritage, where Eastern and Western influences converge, the evening's cocktail reception presented a gastronomic showcase of Wynn's exceptional culinary talent in a vibrant and sophisticated setting. The award-winning teams from seven of Wynn's acclaimed restaurants and bars – Chef Tam's Seasons, Lakeview Palace, Mizumi, SW Steakhouse, and Wing Lei Bar at Wynn Palace, alongside Wing Lei and Drunken Fish at Wynn Macau – came together to present their culinary artistry. The experience was further enriched by authentic Macanese and Portuguese specialties, offering guests a taste of the diverse flavors that reflect the rich culinary heritage of Macao as a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy.


Award-winning wines from the 2026 *Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards* were also showcased throughout the evening, inviting chefs, industry representatives, and guests from around the world to discover the distinctive character of China's diverse terroirs while experiencing Macao's diverse culinary culture, adding a memorable highlight to this international culinary occasion.
